Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: production game HUD sprite, a bottom-right resource readout backing for Forts Zors.O theme.
Primary request: Create ONE isolated horizontal resource panel containing TWO equal stacked rows, metal above and energy below. The whole panel's visible silhouette should be approximately 2.05:1 width:height (wide, not square). Each row is a wide empty recessed dark readout area. A small pale lavender hammer icon sits in the far LEFT narrow column of the top row and a small pale lavender lightning bolt in the left narrow column of the bottom row. The icons occupy only the left 11 percent of the panel; the remaining 85 percent of each row is uninterrupted dark blank space for live game amount / capacity text and a smaller rate. No text or numbers.
Input images: Image 1 (cosmic-purple-number-plate): exact style and colour reference. Image 2 (sprite sheet): reference for the two-row spy panel near bottom middle, pale resource icons and material. Image 3 (PanelRight): STRUCTURE reference only for the vanilla metal-over-energy arrangement; do not copy its infinity signs, grey slab or extra left panel.
Style/medium: crisp front-facing 2D game UI texture matching the existing Zors.O graphics. Subtle dark purple nebula within the rows; dark graphite-purple slim bezel and restrained violet to magenta neon edge, rounded outer corners. Use reference 1's thin luminous rim and dark quiet interior. Narrow middle divider between the two rows, no large decoration.
Composition: one standalone two-row panel centred and fully visible on a truly transparent background, little transparent margin, no perspective, no shadow cast on a background. Whole visible panel ratio 2.05:1. Both blank text rows take equal height. Continuous outside silhouette with rounded corners, one division across the middle. Keep a clear right edge.
Constraints: empty readout slots, small resource icons only in left column. No buttons below, no gauges, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no slash, no infinity symbol, no watermark, no extra UI pieces. Do not render a screenshot or a mockup scene. Actual alpha transparency.
